={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 600,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual: English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background
- Data science bootcamp experience
- Technical skills: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Marketing skills: Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Project experience: dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Job to apply for:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Why it fits: {{ $json.why_good_fit }}

Job description excerpt:
{{ $json.description.substring(0, 1000) }}

Write a cover letter that:
- Is specific to this job and company
- Mentions how Jerry can reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, and turn messy data into business action
- Keeps it under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- Does NOT use hollow phrases like 'I am excited to apply' or 'I would love to join'
- Starts with a strong opening line relevant to the role

Return only the cover letter text, no subject line."
    }
  ]
}
